result:
Done.

**Root cause:** `updateTerminal` (movegen.inc) called `moverInCheck` — which ignores its A argument and tests `sideToMove XOR 8` — instead of `inCheckSide`, so after a mate it asked whether the *winner* was in check, got "no", and fell through to the stalemate branch.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug07/movegen.inc` — the fix (line 1180, `call moverInCheck` → `call inCheckSide`) plus a doc comment on `moverInCheck` warning it ignores A
- `variants/bug07/test_terminal.py` — new, 7-case regression test
- `variants/bug07/Makefile` — `test` target now runs it
- `variants/bug07/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt; exactly one byte differs from pre-fix (`0x5F`→`0x47`, the CALL's low operand byte), same file size
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root

**Gates**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS (all 3 mates announce the right winner; both controls unchanged)
- `make test` — PASS, exit 0 (golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft self-test, save/load round-trip, 128K banked TT, + 7 terminal cases)
- New test — PASS 7/7 on the fixed build, and validated in the other direction: 4 fail / 3 controls green on a pre-fix tape
- Characterisation suite — PASS 57/57, exit 0 (pre-fix: 54 ok, 3 failed — exactly `tm_fools_mate`, `tm_scholars_mate`, `se_mate_in_one`). Note its default `--harness` points outside this workspace and must be overridden
- Review round — 1 of 3, synchronous, **no defect found in the fix**; gate closed

The reviewer independently rebuilt from source, reconstructed a pre-fix tape, confirmed `isAttacked` returns A ∈ {0,1} (so `or a / jr z` tests the right thing), verified no other call site has the defect, corroborated the one-byte diff by symbol arithmetic, mutation-tested my test (2 mutants, both killed), and re-ran characterisation under a second scheduling profile. Its category-(B) findings are recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`; two that were cheap and risk-free I applied and re-verified — every case now also asserts the exact final FEN/side, and the `moverInCheck` comment was confirmed to change zero bytes (md5 identical).

**Knowingly left open** (all category B, none a defect in the fix): mate by promotion/castling/en passant and mate coinciding with a draw boundary are not pinned by a committed case, though the reviewer spot-probed promotion-mate and 100th-halfmove-mate and both are correct; and three pre-existing issues untouched because they behave identically before and after the fix — an already-terminal *loaded* position reports `play`, `takeBack` clears draw verdicts without re-deriving them, and the `gameState` comment at chess.asm:46 is stale.
